name: New Home Sales
consensus_source: No October 2026 consensus found in one search
read: New home sales rose 14.2% to 701k SAAR in October from a revised 614k (September first printed 676k). No consensus found. Contract signings rebounded, but the gain is off a downward-revised base and the level is only 3.7% above the first September print.

reasons: no consensus available; surprise not assessed
